variants.headline: Looking back: accident at a workplace
variants.sub: The colony has had an accident at a workplace.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: An accident had occurred at a workplace in {colony}.

Going to work should not make a person's safety an afterthought. Labour has every reason to insist on that principle. We should also distinguish an accident from an unreported finding about its cause, because solidarity requires a truthful account as well as a firm demand for decent conditions.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The role of {target} merits scrutiny against the accident. This paper does not presume a breach of rules or announce consequences for workers that have not been established in the reported particulars.

variants.headline: Looking back: workplace safety becomes immediate news
variants.sub: A workplace in the colony has been the scene of an accident.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: The colony had had an accident at a workplace.

Going to work should not make a person's safety an afterthought. Labour has every reason to insist on that principle. We should also distinguish an accident from an unreported finding about its cause, because solidarity requires a truthful account as well as a firm demand for decent conditions.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

The role of {target} merits scrutiny against the accident. This paper does not presume a breach of rules or announce consequences for workers that have not been established in the reported particulars.

variants.headline: Looking back: an accident enters the working day
variants.sub: An accident has occurred at a workplace in {colony}.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: A workplace in the colony had been the scene of an accident.

Going to work should not make a person's safety an afterthought. Labour has every reason to insist on that principle. We should also distinguish an accident from an unreported finding about its cause, because solidarity requires a truthful account as well as a firm demand for decent conditions.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

The role of {target} merits scrutiny against the accident. This paper does not presume a breach of rules or announce consequences for workers that have not been established in the reported particulars.
